headline: **MLB Daily Recap: August 1, 2026**
article:
The New York Yankees secured a shutout victory over the Chicago Cubs, winning 2-0. Will Warren pitched 6.2 innings with 7 strikeouts and no earned runs. In other action, the Cincinnati Reds edged out the Pittsburgh Pirates 8-7, while the Baltimore Orioles took down the Philadelphia Phillies 6-4.

Injuries and availability continue to impact teams. The Minnesota Twins transferred right-handed pitcher Mike Paredes to the 60-day injured list due to a left oblique strain. The Los Angeles Dodgers placed right-handed pitcher Brock Stewart on the 15-day injured list with right shoulder discomfort. Other teams have also made injury-related moves, including the Detroit Tigers, Seattle Mariners, New York Mets, Tampa Bay Rays, Chicago Cubs, and Minnesota Twins.

The Milwaukee Brewers bolstered their catching depth with a trade, acquiring catcher Bo Naylor and right-handed pitcher Codi Heuer from the Cleveland Guardians in exchange for center fielder Blake Perkins and right-handed pitcher Craig Yoho. The Baltimore Orioles also made a trade, sending right-handed pitcher Dean Kremer to the Minnesota Twins in exchange for outfielder Jhomnardo Reyes.

top_news.title: **Yankees Shut Down Cubs 2-0**
top_news.summary: The New York Yankees secured a shutout victory over the Chicago Cubs, winning 2-0. Will Warren led the way for the Yankees, pitching 6.2 innings with 7 strikeouts and no earned runs.

top_news.title: **Reds Rally Past Pirates in Thrilling Finish**
top_news.summary: The Cincinnati Reds edged out the Pittsburgh Pirates 8-7 in a closely contested game. Sal Stewart led the Pirates' offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 4 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Phillies Fall to Orioles in Thrilling Finish**
top_news.summary: The Baltimore Orioles edged out the Philadelphia Phillies 6-4, securing a crucial win. Pete Alonso led the Phillies' offense with a 2-hit, 1-home run performance, while Andrew Painter pitched 6 strong innings for the Phillies.

top_news.title: **Cardinals Fall to Blue Jays 3-1**
top_news.summary: The Toronto Blue Jays took down the St. Louis Cardinals 3-1, securing a crucial win. Luis Urías led the Cardinals' offense with a single, 2 RBI, and 1 AB.

top_news.title: **Twins RHP Mike Paredes Shifted to 60-Day IL**
top_news.summary: Minnesota Twins right-handed pitcher Mike Paredes has been transferred from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to a left oblique strain.

top_news.title: **Brewers Bolster Catching Depth with Trade**
top_news.summary: The Milwaukee Brewers have acquired catcher Bo Naylor and right-handed pitcher Codi Heuer from the Cleveland Guardians in exchange for center fielder Blake Perkins and right-handed pitcher Craig Yoho.
